correctness.rationale: For every \(0<t<1\), direct expansion gives \(t e_1e_1^*+(1-t)e_1e_1^*+e_2e_2^*=I\), with all scaling coefficients positive and frame-vector norms \(1,2,3\). The source proof was checked at the exact trace step. The strict uniqueness boundary follows from injectivity of the real-linear outer-product map and a small kernel perturbation of a positive squared-scaling vector.

value.rationale: A published theorem and corollary-level remark are false even for ordinary frames with all norms distinct and every scaling coefficient positive. The correction identifies the exact structural reason and the strict uniqueness boundary, so it changes the mathematical conclusion rather than merely improving exposition.
